description: Keeping state in the component that uses it, and moving it up only as far as its consumers require.
Putting single-consumer UI state in a global store. Causes extra re-renders, coupling and instances that share state by accident.
The component or provider that owns a piece of state. Everything below can use it; good boundaries follow features.
Changing a component's `key` remounts it with fresh local state, e.g. `<CommentBox key={post.id} />`.
Selecting only the slice a component reads (`useStore((state) => state.theme)`) so unrelated changes do not re-render it.
